faqs.q: Sec. 54-302. - Micromobility operator permit and pilot program.
faqs.a:
To assist with the implementation and operation of micromobility within the city,
               the director shall create the "mobility as a service permit program." The director
               shall establish a permit application process, and develop program criteria and requirements
               for micromobility operation within the city's rights-of-way.
(Ord. No.
4772
, § 8, 8-16-2021)
